# Better Craft
Better Craft is a modpack designed to enhance the classic Minecraft survival experience without losing the vanilla essence. With a focus on immersion and quality of life, it adds new animations, improved textures, subtle visual details, and small improvements that make the world feel more alive and interesting to explore

# NEWS
- ✨ New creature animations
- ⛰️ New biomes and structures
- 🌿 New details
- 📱 New loading screen

## More to come
